description:
Get full sourced details for one agent harness by slug.

Use when: you have a harness slug (from list_harnesses) and need its sources, caveats, pricing or feature evidence.

Behavior: Read-only. Returns the harness with source URLs and links to related Vibe Shipped pages, or isError (not_found).

Example: {"slug":"openai-codex-cli"}

slug.description: Harness slug, e.g. claude-code, openai-codex-cli, aider, langgraph.

name: get_harness
title: Get one agent harness
